title: LiteLLM readiness per pod
description: What each pod of the workload answered on /health/readiness through the API server's pod proxy. ready is true for 200 with status healthy, false for 503 or another status, null when the pod was not asked or the answer was an error. cache, litellmVersion and successCallbacks are present only when the proxy serves the detailed payload publicly (allow_public_health_readiness_details); db is in the public payload (connected, Not connected when no database is configured, disconnected).

queriedCount.description: Pods asked (Running ones, at most 10; a failed ask still counts)

unaskedCount.description: Pods of the workload not asked: not Running, past the cap of 10, or past maxItems (a scoped error names them)

queried.description: false for a pod that is not Running or was not asked before the deadline

ready.description: true for a 200 healthy; false for a 503 (see cause) or another status; null when the ask failed

db.description: connected, Not connected (no database configured), disconnected (a 200 with this means allow_requests_on_db_unavailable is set, or an older version that does not 503)

cache.description: the cache type; null when none is configured or the payload is the public one

detailed.description: the detailed payload (version, cache, callbacks) was present

truncated.description: a text field was cut at 1024 characters

cause.description: Only for a 503: db_unreachable_likely when liveness answered 200 (LiteLLM 503s readiness for a configured database it cannot reach, and liveness only during shutdown), draining when liveness also answered 503, undetermined when liveness could not tell. Verified against LiteLLM 1.102.1

livenessHttpStatus.description: The status liveness gave when asked for the cause of a 503
